title: Analyzing Road Network Inefficiency via Simulation: Towards a MARL Evaluation Testbed
abstract: The Price of Anarchy (PoA) quantifies the efficiency loss that emerges in traffic networks when drivers make route choices selfishly rather than cooperatively.
